parsed.rationale: All four records are empty interfaces (fields_or_signature: [], shared_field_count: 2 shared structural slots) spread across four packages — Playback, Wallpaper, MusicShareKit, and Analytics — with none flagged as test, codegen, mock, or sample-app. A dedicated `AnalyticsEvent` protocol already exists in `Shared/Analytics/Sources/Analytics/AnalyticsEvent.swift` (package: Analytics), making it the natural canonical parent. `PlaybackAnalyticsEvent`, `QualityAnalyticsEvent`, and `RequestLineAnalyticsEvent` should be redeclared as refinements of `AnalyticsEvent` (i.e., `protocol PlaybackAnalyticsEvent: AnalyticsEvent {}`), eliminating the structural duplication while preserving domain-specific naming for each subsystem. This approach requires no new package and leverages the existing Analytics package that the other three packages can depend on.
